A backup is one encrypted file with everything in your vault. Qasa doesn\'t upload it anywhere: you choose where it\'s saved. Pick a folder in Google Drive or iCloud Drive, so you can get your vault back if you lose the phone or delete Qasa. It opens only with your main password.
Each new backup replaces this device\'s previous one, automatic or manual.
